class.name: CgamePhysicsTimeline
class.brief_description: Per-step physics profiler with phase timings and Chrome trace export.
class.description: [CgamePhysicsTimeline] records, for every [CgameDeterministicPhysics] step, the wall-clock time spent in the phases [code]broadphase[/code], [code]narrowphase[/code], [code]solve[/code] and [code]integrate[/code], together with contact, pair, sleeping and body counters. Records are kept in a bounded ring buffer of [member capacity] steps. [method report] aggregates them and [method export_json] produces a trace in the Chrome Trace Event Format that can be opened in [code]chrome://tracing[/code] or Perfetto. Attach it with [method CgameDeterministicPhysics.set_timeline]. Timings are wall-clock values and are never part of the simulation state, so profiling cannot affect determinism. [codeblock] var timeline := CgamePhysicsTimeline.new() world.timeline = timeline # ... run the simulation ... print(timeline.report_text()) FileAccess.open("user://physics_trace.json", FileAccess.WRITE).store_string(timeline.export_json()) [/codeblock]

method.name: begin_phase
method.description: Starts timing a phase. Called automatically when the timeline is attached to a physics world; scripts can use it to time their own phases.

method.name: end_phase
method.description: Ends the current phase and appends it to the current step record.

method.name: end_step
method.description: Finishes the current step record. [param stats] may contain the integer counters [code]contacts[/code], [code]pairs[/code], [code]sleeping[/code] and [code]bodies[/code].

method.name: get_phases
method.description: Returns the names of the profiled phases.

method.name: phase_us
method.description: Returns the total microseconds spent in [param phase] during one record returned by [method records].

method.name: record_count
method.description: Returns the number of recorded steps.

method.name: records
method.description: Returns the recorded steps as dictionaries with the keys [code]step[/code], [code]start_us[/code], [code]dur_us[/code], [code]phases[/code] (an array of [code]{name, start_us, dur_us}[/code]), [code]contacts[/code], [code]pairs[/code], [code]sleeping[/code] and [code]bodies[/code].

method.name: to_trace
method.description: Returns a Chrome trace object [code]{"traceEvents": [...]}[/code]. Timestamps are microseconds relative to the oldest recorded step.

members.member: Maximum number of step records kept; the oldest are dropped first.
